content.description: The paths of the Skada Entrada and The NOVA intertwine, the Trio, including Skarde, who encounters with Nova Ministro Cillian and a new young leader named Lars. The Three Progenitors blessed the Seekers with unmatched power and resources to kickstart this movement. Without him, there is no Havoc Worlds. Tasked with sharing insights into this enigmatic event, the Skada Entrada faces a daunting challenge that could unravel secrets beyond their imagination. Will they speak of the ordeal that had occured amongst the region?
